'''Datoro Scorn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mercenary/Legends|hired-gun]]. At one point, Scorn had an encounter with the mercenary [[Lex Kempo]] that when poorly for Scorn, who was shot in the face with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolt, leaving him hideously scarred. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Scorn was hired to defend the criminal entrepreneur [[Begas Tok]] during an auction of the [[Shard of Alderaan]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicing]] program that was to take place aboard the ''[[Dune Princess]]'' [[Sail barge/Legends|sail barge]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="The Shard of Alderaan">{{WEGCite|story=The Shard of Alderaan|book=Live-Action Adventures}}</ref>
